about_the_game:
"Tank Core" is a 2D top-down shooter game infused with Roguelike elements. Players will collect various random tank components in levels, including turrets, chassis, shells, modules, and cores, to assemble unique tanks that will protect base and defeat all enemies encountered.

About Demo

In the demo, only a limited amount of gameplay content is currently available, with more updates to come in the future. Stay tuned.

Overview of currently available content in the demo:

-Dozens of player components (including turrets, chassis, shells, modules, and cores)

-One playable map, consisting of various enemies, terrains, and randomly selected levels

-Simple custom level and map creation features

Free Combination

By installing various collected tank components, you can create unique combat strategies. These components include turrets, chassis, shells, and modules.

Endless Cores

Various cores will provide your tank with comprehensive passive bonuses, and there’s no limit to the number of cores you can equip. Melt down extra turrets and bases to forge specific cores, which will retain some effects of the original components.

Complex Terrain

Engage enemies in a variety of complex terrains where the landscape is both an obstacle and an ally. Interact with or destroy the terrain as needed.

Build Levels

Unlock special terrain pieces in the editor by continually fighting. Create your own custom levels according to your preferences.
